text:
jane_support: @customer_acme thanks for the report — you said this started immediately after the scheduled cert rotation?
customer_acme: yes, started ~10:12 UTC. All calls to our private/vpc endpoint 10.10.5.2:443 returning 502 from our LB, client logs show SSL handshake failures. We didn't change our HAProxy config.
jane_support: can you paste the client error + a curl -v against the endpoint from a host inside the customer's VPC?
customer_acme: here's curl from a customer app host:
```
$ curl -v https://10.10.5.2/health
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Certificate unknown
* SSL peer failed to verify certificate
* Closing connection 0
curl: (51) SSL: certificate subject name mismatch or unable to verify the first certificate
```
jane_support: thanks. I ran openssl s_client from a support bastion that can reach the same IP. Output shows missing intermediate in the presented chain:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect 10.10.5.2:443 -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = redwood-priv.example.com
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
0 s:/CN=redwood-priv.example.com
1 s:/CN=Redwood Intermediary CA (cross-signed)
---
```
jane_support: rotator/status bot shows rotation job succeeded at 10:05 UTC: job id rot-2026-17695-09
cert-rotator-bot: Rotation job rot-2026-17695-09 completed, bundle accepted. (sha256: a3b4...f1c9)
ashwin_eng: can you paste the PEM bundle that was uploaded? also any pinned certs on the LB? did the customer pin the intermediate fingerprint?
customer_acme: we pin the intermediate cert thumbprint in HAProxy to prevent surprises. config snippet:
```
frontend https-in
  bind *:443 ssl crt /etc/haproxy/certs/combined.pem
  # pinned intermediate fingerprint: 7f:2a:...:b3
```
jane_support: uploaded bundle from rotator (redacted):
```
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
(leaf)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
(intermediate B - cross-signed)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
(root)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```
jon_ops: I compared the fingerprint of the intermediate we served before rotation vs now. They differ. Pre-rotation intermediate fingerprint was 7f:2a:...:b3 (matches customer's pinned). New intermediate is 9c:d1:...:e7 (cross-signed alternative). Looks like rotator uploaded a chain that omits the original intermediate key the customer expected.
eng-ssl: interesting — same subject but different key (cross-signed intermediate). If the customer pins the specific fingerprint, their LB will reject the new chain even if the new chain is valid to other CAs. That explains the verify errors.
ashwin_eng: do we have rotator logs for why bundle changed? could be an upstream CA rotation that introduced a cross-signed intermediate and our rotator picked the new intermediate automatically.
cert-rotator-bot: rot-2026-17695-09: source CA rotated intermediary at 2026-06-07T09:58:00Z, bundle builder picked highest-trust path per default resolver.
jane_support: customer is stuck — options: 1) re-pin to new fingerprint (customer action), 2) re-upload a bundle including the original intermediate key (if we still have that cert and it's valid), 3) ask LB to stop pinning to intermediate.
customer_acme: we want to avoid touching prod HAProxy during business hours. Can Redwood re-upload a bundle that contains the old intermediate so our pin continues working?
jon_ops: we still have archived previous intermediate (fingerprint 7f:2a:...:b3) for 30 days. I can build a bundle with leaf + old-intermediate + root and push it to the customer's private control plane as a temporary hotfix.
eng-ssl: long term we should warn customers when intermediate/key changes. Also rotator should validate that replacing an intermediate with a different key when the subject matches triggers a warning and email to configured contacts, especially for Private/VPC customers with pinning enabled.
ashwin_eng: agreed. I'll open an engineering ticket for rotator validation + admin alert. For now: jon, can you stage the hotfix bundle and mark it as a manual override for this customer?
jon_ops: will do. ETA 25m.
jane_support: sending steps to customer to test once I push - please hold on making LB changes for 30m.
customer_acme: thanks. will stand by and not change HAProxy.
jon_ops: pushed manual bundle override to customer tenant at 10:35 UTC, bundle id tmp-rot-17695-9b. Please test.
customer_acme: testing now... curl works! HTTP 200 /health. :thumbsup:
jane_support: great, I'll keep this thread open until eng-ssl follows up with a rotator mitigation and until the customer confirms stability for 24h.
eng-ssl: ticket INFR-1428 opened: add intermediate-key-change detection + admin email + ability to opt-in to maintain previous intermediate for pinned customers. assigning to @ashwin_eng.
ashwin_eng: noted, I'll prioritize a small validation change in the rotator (warn on subject match + fingerprint mismatch) and a follow-up PR to expose override flows in the console.
jane_support: thanks everyone. tagging @cert-rotator-bot to include rotation metadata in the incident notes. :white_check_mark:
cert-rotator-bot: noted. incident-ref rot-2026-17695-09 -> INFR-1428.
customer_acme: appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll monitor and reply here with any regressions.
